text:
maria.customer: Hey — signed up a few minutes ago but my free trial credits never appeared. Email is verified, dashboard shows $0 credits. Account ID acc_1768abc123. I'm in Germany 🇩🇪, added a card during signup (last4 4242). Can someone check?

alice_support: Sorry for the trouble — can you confirm the signup email and whether you completed payment method verification? Don't post full card details publicly, just last4 is fine. We'll triage.

maria.customer: email: maria@acme.com, last4 4242, email_verified: true. I didn't get any SMS. I tried an API call and got 401 but that might be unrelated. Dashboard still shows zero trial credits.

alice_support: Thanks. Checking internal account meta... @cary_billing can you pull billing/withhold flags for acc_1768abc123?

cary_billing: Pulling logs now. From billing system: payment_method_status = requires_verification, pm_bin_country = US, account_region = DE, trial_gate = pm_country_mismatch. System withheld trial because card BIN country (US) != account region (DE) and PM not verified. Email is verified though.

dana_eng: For visibility: our gating rule (recent anti-abuse change) blocks auto trial grants when pm_bin_country != account_region and the payment method hasn't completed verification. Repro command: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" https://console.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acc_1768abc123
# response snippet
{
  "id": "acc_1768abc123",
  "region": "DE",
  "email_verified": true,
  "trial_status": "withheld",
  "withhold_reason": "pm_country_mismatch",
  "payment_method": {"last4": "4242", "bin_country": "US", "status": "requires_verification"}
}
```

alice_support: Maria — we can do one of three things: (1) you add a payment method with an EU card and let Stripe verify (auto-release in ~10m), (2) complete phone verification if prompted, or (3) we can manually grant as a one-time exception after a quick billing check. Which do you prefer?

maria.customer: I don't want to upload photos. I'll try adding a local EU card. If that doesn't work can you manually grant? How fast is manual?

cary_billing: If you add an EU card and Stripe finishes micro-deposit / verification, our system should auto-unwithhold within ~10 minutes. Manual grant by billing ops usually takes up to 2 business hours; I can expedite now.

alice_support: For now, I've initiated a manual exception. ACTION: manual_trial_grant by alice_support -> +$200 credits to acc_1768abc123. Audit ref grant_20260309_01. This is logged and will be reviewed per policy. Maria, please refresh.

maria.customer: I see the credits now — thanks so much! :raised_hands:

cary_billing: Noted — leaving a comment on the billing record: "manual grant due to pm_bin_country mismatch and customer declined image upload; recommended to add EU PM or phone verification."

dana_eng: Filing an internal ticket to review the gating heuristic for low-risk signups and to improve the error message in the UI so customers aren't left guessing. Ticket INF-3192 created.

alice_support: Quick summary we will send to you: free trial auto-grant can be blocked by payment-method country mismatch or unverified PM. Options: add a verified EU card or ask us to manually grant after minimal checks. Sorry for the friction — we're working to make this clearer in the signup flow.

maria.customer: Great, appreciate the fast help. Closing for me unless it happens again.

[system note] stripe-bot: payment_method update for acc_1768abc123 -> requires_verification (bin_country=US)

[reaction] alice_support reacted with :white_check_mark: to maria.customer's last message.
